subject: Copywriting
title: AI-Generated Copy
description: A fast breakdown of AI-Generated Copy for builders.

hook.text: In 2022, ChatGPT wrote ad copy in seconds. Copywriters panicked. Was the profession over?

buildup.text: AI could produce headlines, taglines, and product descriptions faster than any human. Volume was instant.

discovery.text: But AI copy sounded generic. It lacked the weird, human, surprising angles that make great ads memorable.

twist.text: Smart copywriters didn't fight AI—they used it for drafts and focused on strategy and voice.

climax.text: AI democratized basic copy. Elite copywriting—the kind that builds brands—became more valuable, not less.

punchline.text: AI writes copy. Humans write the copy that matters.

quiz.question: How did the best copywriters respond to AI?
options: They used AI for drafts and focused on strategy
